decisions.reason: After four years with no further website visibility, this close but relatively low-commitment template looks easier to abandon now that temporary underperformance is harder to justify and design resources can be redirected.

The responsive website template still fits the customer base, but its weak public commitment and long silence make continuation less compelling than reallocating effort to more strategic hosting and support offers.

Premium customer support is central to the firm's announced agency-focused, expert-service positioning, so management is likely to keep backing it despite limited observable evidence because dropping it would conflict with its core promise.
The software version management tool built on the firm's platform and had its own page, so sunk development effort and its role in reducing recurring operational work still favor continuation.

Although the data-processing-contract tool involved visible investment and a product line, it remains comparatively distant from the hosting core, and after several years weak signals can no longer be blamed as temporary.
Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, multi-model offer tightly tied to the firm's core direction and public commitments, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
